parts.label: Part 2
parts.article:
Part two. You will hear the supervisor of a home improvement store giving a tour of the store to some new staff.

First, you will have some time to look at questions eleven to fifteen.

Now listen carefully and answer questions eleven to fifteen.

Welcome to today's staff orientation at the home improvement store. My name is John. I look after new staff, and I'll be with you here in the training room all morning.

We are the biggest hardware store in the country, and as home improvement is now so popular, hundreds of customers visit our store each week to buy products to improve every part of their house, inside or out. First, let me introduce you to the most popular sections of our superstore. Can you all take a look at the store plan you have in front of you?

We stock every kind of flooring, including carpets, wooden flooring, and tiling. Our paint department is next to flooring. Um, that's it in the bottom right-hand corner of the map. We offer advice to customers on color combinations for inside or outside before they purchase.

We've become well-known in the last few years for selling the latest kitchen designs for all budgets, and we also stock quality appliances recommended by top chefs. These products can be found right in the middle of the store, just next to electrical goods. You may not be aware that one reason we are such a popular store is our great cafe, which serves cheap, nutritious lunches. That's in the top right of your map. Staff should also make customers aware of the children's play area, which is between the cafe and flooring, so mom and dad can get something to eat or drink or even continue their shopping while the kids are safe with our trained childcare workers.

Now, what else should I mention? Ah, yes. We recently moved our stock of showers and baths from the left side of the store to the area along the back wall next to the tool section. We offer practical advice to customers about their bathrooms before they buy, such as where to locate a new toilet or shower.

I have left my favorite area till last, gardens. It's marked on the left side of the map after the staff area and before the tool section. There you'll find our extensive range of plants, flowers, and related products for inside or outside. If you get to work there, I'm sure you'll find it a very pleasant section to work in. Right. Well, that's it for the store plan.

Before you hear the rest of the talk, you have some time to look at questions sixteen to twenty on page five.

Now listen and answer questions sixteen to twenty.

Now, there is some other general information I need to give you before you start your specific training. The first thing staff need to know is what makes us different to our competitors. Our main advantage, due to our size, is that we can cut our costs and offer the best deals. Of course, we are proud of the great service we provide to our customers, especially through our help desk.

We also have an excellent choice of goods so that we can provide plenty of options to our customers. But of course, that isn't unique to us. The Home Improvement Store has sixty stores nationwide, and we promote our stores and products in a range of different ways. First, there's our catalog, which lists all our items. It's been around for years, but we still have a policy of staff use only. The most important marketing material, and the one you want to ensure is given to every customer, is our store magazine, showing the latest products, workshops, and offers. The website is being redeveloped at the moment, so customers can't access it right now.

The Home Improvement Store is a great place to work. Like most of the staff, I'm sure you'll appreciate the fact that you can choose your hours to fit your lifestyle, family, or study. We hope you'll find that there's a nice atmosphere here. We are thinking of introducing a staff discount on our products, so that would be a real benefit to all staff.

Every weekend, we offer workshops to help customers carry out their own home improvements. Workshops range from indoor painting to outdoor gardening and plant ideas. This coming weekend, there'll be one on mending a broken fence. Please remind customers of the workshops, especially if there is one related to your section.

Finally, I wanted to let you know about a special deal for people renovating their kitchen. As you know, we sell all products and appliances connected to the kitchen, and we also have a delivery service. If customers buy one of our total kitchen designs, we will install it free of charge. So, let's take a short break, and then we'll start...

That is the end of section two. You now have half a minute to check your answers.

analyses.content: 录音中明确说明了油漆区（paint department）的位置，就在地图的右下角（bottom right-hand corner）。
Our paint department is next to flooring. Um, that's it in the bottom right-hand corner of the map.
地图题最怕抓错参照物，这里你只要听到“bottom right-hand corner”这个绝对方位词，无需过度思考路线，就能直接锁定右下角的对应字母。

We've become well-known in the last few years for selling the latest kitchen designs for all budgets, and we also stock quality appliances recommended by top chefs. These products can be found right in the middle of the store, just next to electrical goods.
你可能会被前面的一长串背景介绍（如 top chefs、all budgets）绕晕导致没跟上录音，做地图题一定要耐心等到表示方位的核心词“in the middle of the store”出现再做定位。
录音直接提到，这些厨房产品（These products）可以在商店的正中间（right in the middle of the store）找到。

Staff should also make customers aware of the children's play area, which is between the cafe and flooring, so mom and dad can get something to eat or drink or even continue their shopping while the kids are safe with our trained childcare workers.
这里用的是“between A and B”的经典定位句型，如果你没听清这个行进结构，很容易把答案错选成它旁边的某个单独区域。
录音明确指出了儿童游乐区（children's play area）的位置，它夹在咖啡馆和地板区之间（between the cafe and flooring）。
We recently moved our stock of showers and baths from the left side of the store to the area along the back wall next to the tool section.
录音里提到了“left side（左边）”，但这是它们“过去”的位置（moved...from...），你必须顺着时间线往后听，抓住“现在”的位置也就是后墙（back wall）和工具区（tool section）旁边。
录音说淋浴和浴缸区（showers and baths）被移到了后墙边上，紧挨着工具区（along the back wall next to the tool section）。
I have left my favorite area till last: gardens. It's marked on the left side of the map after the staff area and before the tool section.
这里连续出现了三个参照方位（左边、员工区、工具区），只要你紧跟“左侧”这个大方向，并在两个已知区域中间找，就不会迷失路线。
录音中指出花园区（gardens）在地图的左边（left side），位于员工区之后、工具区之前（after the staff area and before the tool section）。

questions.question: What makes the Home Improve Store special?

analyses.content: 录音提到这家店与竞争对手不同的主要优势是规模大，因此能降低成本并提供最划算的价格（cut our costs and offer the best deals），完美对应A选项的价格低。

The first thing staff need to know is what makes us different to our competitors. Our main advantage, due to our size, is that we can cut our costs and offer the best deals. Of course, we are proud of the great service we provide to our customers, especially through our help desk. We also have an excellent choice of goods so that we can provide plenty of options to our customers. But of course, that isn't unique to us.
你可能听到了优质的客户服务（great service）和丰富的商品选择（excellent choice of goods）想选B或C，但紧接着录音就强调了“这些并不是我们独有的（isn't unique to us）”，通过识别这些干扰信息可以帮你迅速排错。

questions.question: What should staff promote to customers?

analyses.content: First, there's our catalog, which lists all our items. It's been around for years, but we still have a policy of staff use only. The most important marketing material, and the one you want to ensure is given to every customer, is our store magazine, showing the latest products, workshops, and offers. The website is being redeveloped at the moment, so customers can't access it right now.
你极易被A和C的并列信息干扰：录音明确说产品目录（catalog）“仅限员工使用（staff use only）”，而网站（website）“正在重建，顾客现在上不去（can't access it right now）”，理清这些限定条件就能排除干扰项。
录音要求员工必须确保发给每位顾客（given to every customer）的是商店杂志（store magazine），对应B选项。

questions.question: What do the current staff like best about working in the store?

analyses.content: Like most of the staff, I'm sure you'll appreciate the fact that you can choose your hours to fit your lifestyle, family, or study. We hope you'll find that there's a nice atmosphere here. We are thinking of introducing a staff discount on our products, so that would be a real benefit to all staff.
你可能会听到氛围好（nice atmosphere）和员工折扣（staff discount），但这只是“希望你们觉得好”以及“正考虑引入（thinking of introducing）”的未来规划，不仔细看选项的话很容易错当成目前的福利。
录音说大多数员工最欣赏的一点是，你可以自由选择工作时间（choose your hours）来配合你的生活，对应C选项的弹性工作时间。

questions.question: What will the next workshop be about?

analyses.content: Workshops range from indoor painting to outdoor gardening and plant ideas. This coming weekend, there'll be one on mending a broken fence.
录音前半段提到了室内油漆（indoor painting）和户外园艺（outdoor gardening），但这些都是“平时的研讨会范围（range from...）”，你必须抓准核心提问的时间词“This coming weekend（下周末）”来排除前面出现的强干扰。
录音明确指出，下个周末的研讨会将是关于如何修补破损的栅栏（mending a broken fence），对应B选项。

questions.question: What special deal does the company offer when people buy a new kitchen?

analyses.content: As you know, we sell all products and appliances connected to the kitchen, and we also have a delivery service. If customers buy one of our total kitchen designs, we will install it free of charge.
你可能会因为听到电器（appliances）和配送服务（delivery service）而想选A或B，但这只是常规的售卖和配送介绍，真正的“特别优惠条件（if customers buy...we will...）”是落在免费安装上的。
录音最后提到，如果顾客购买了全套厨房设计，商店将免费为其进行安装（install it free of charge），对应C选项的免费安装。
